West Bengal Government Announces New Metro Line in Kolkata

The West Bengal government has announced plans to build a new metro line in Kolkata, with the aim of improving public transportation in the city. The project is expected to be completed within two years and will have 32 stations along its route. The announcement was made by the state's transport minister, who said that the new line will reduce travel time between different parts of the city. Critics say that the project will benefit only a select few and that it does not address the root causes of traffic congestion in Kolkata.
